title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 170 Manhattan Avenue in Buffalo, New York, as the "Indiana Hunt-Martin Post Office Building".
official_summary: This bill designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 170 Manhattan Avenue in Buffalo, New York, as the Indiana Hunt-Martin Post Office Building.

summary.headline: Congress named a Buffalo, New York post office building after Indiana Hunt-Martin, with no change to how the building operates.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 170 Manhattan Avenue in Buffalo, New York, as the Indiana Hunt-Martin Post Office Building. It is an honorary designation. The post office keeps its existing mail services and daily operations.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on October 11, 2022, and the new name applied from that date.
